about: Model Weather's reading of a field's picture at a point (the engine's flow_cell and flow_sample), held by the engine (engine/facade/tests/flow_sample.rs) and the web (features/weather-flow/flowTexture.test.ts), and to be by the phones' FlowGrid. The picture as the weather service's flow_grid writes it: bounds its pixels' outer edges, north row first; each pixel [red, green, alpha] bytes, a 255th of unscale a step, the wind's east part in red and north in green.

cells.about: Between four pixel middles: half way east, a quarter south

samples.about: A westerly of 50 kt beside an easterly of 50 kt, half way: calm, where an average of the speeds would read 50
A wind from the west at 50 kt
A scalar a quarter of the way from 0 to 100
None where a pixel it is read from has none
